title: Scalar Vacuum Polarization in Loop Quantum Gravity Black Holes
summary: A quantum macroscopic ``Kruskal'' black hole solution that incorporates quantum geometry effects has been derived in Loop Quantum Gravity as the counterpart to the classical Schwarzschild solution with a distinct imprint outside the event horizon, even at scales much larger than the Planck length. This resulting black hole quantum geometry is supported by an effective energy density of quantum origin, outside the horizon, which prevents asymptotic flatness at large distances and confines massive particles to finite radii, thereby preventing their escape to infinity.
